fato_historico: 1980: The 43rd government of Turkey is overthrown in a coup d'état led by General Kenan Evren.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound shift in your personal structures, much like the changing tides of history that once reshaped a nation. It is a good time to consider building stability from within, perhaps letting go of outdated patterns that no longer serve your growth. Embrace the stillness of the earth and nurture your inner peace as you reorganize your beautiful life.
frase_do_dia: Steady foundations allow your spirit to bloom even in the most changing times.
significado_numero: Represents the power of transformation and building a solid new legacy.
conselho: Trust your pace and remain grounded while embracing the inevitable changes around you.
